summary: Refactor 'Compartir Propiedades' (single source of truth = publications['web-varela'].url) verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass — publicUrl format '.../?propiedad=<idPublico>' on GET /api/properties (29/29 web-published, 0 inconsistent, 0 null), publicUrl null on draft, /api/public/listings and /listings/{id} expose canonical publicUrl from single source, whatsappUrl derives from that same URL (contains 'propiedad=vera-9c1d4217-...' url-encoded + 'source=website' tracking), POST .../publications/web-varela publish is idempotent and persists {status:'published', url:'.../?propiedad=vera-9c1d4217-...'}, PATCH with unchanged title preserves publications['web-varela'].url (auto re-sync does not clear it). Frontend: on /propiedades, card menu of published property 9c1d4217 shows enabled 'Compartir' (menu-share-<id>), no disabled variant; clicking copies EXACTLY 'https://www.varelapropiedadescde.com.ar/?propiedad=vera-9c1d4217-2522-4649-a269-bbd536a71f39' to clipboard and displays toast '✅ Propiedad lista para compartir'.
critical_code_review_comments: web_publisher.stored_public_url() is the single reader of the source of truth (publications['web-varela'].url) — used by serializers.property_to_response, routes_public and inquiries.public_url. Clean separation, no URL construction by convention leaks.

routes_properties.set_publication (web-varela publish) correctly delegates to web_publisher.publish() which validates persistence via _row_exists; on failure it persists status='inconsistent' with url='' and returns 502 — matches the requested contract.

update_property re-syncs to web when publications.web-varela.status ∈ {published, inconsistent} and rewrites publications with the URL returned by publish(); on exception it flips to 'inconsistent' + url='' rather than silently leaving stale state. Good.

inquiries.public_url() derives WhatsApp tracking URL from stored_public_url and correctly uses '&' as separator when the base already has '?' (which is the case for '?propiedad=...') — no double-'?' bug.

PropertiesScreen.onShare uses navigator.clipboard.writeText with a legacy execCommand fallback and derives the shared URL exclusively from property.publicUrl (no client-side URL construction) — aligned with backend single-source contract.
Minor (out of scope for this test): _property_code() in serializers.py silently falls back to VAR-000000 on invalid uuid; not exercised in this sprint but worth a defensive log/raise later.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_share_public_url.py (rewritten for new '?propiedad=<idPublico>' format, added whatsappUrl derivation test, publish idempotency test, PATCH re-sync test, single-source-consistency test across ALL properties)
